5540-6084-8195.manaNeeded: {4}{R}{R} plus commander tax if applicable plus {2}{R} if you don't control a commander
5540-6084-8195.easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls two targetable creatures.
5540-6084-8195.description:
Cast Venser by paying {4}{R}{R} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Venser enters, it triggers targeting any applicable target, and Confusion of the Ranks also triggers targeting a creature an opponent controls.
Resolve the Confusion of the Ranks trigger, exchanging control of Venser and the targeted creature.
Holding priority, cast Deflecting Swat by paying at most {2}{R}, changing the target of Venser's trigger to Venser.
Resolve Venser's ability, creating two token copies of it with haste.
Put all but one Venser token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Venser tokens' abilities each trigger, with one trigger targeting the nontoken Venser and the other ability targeting any valid target.
Resolve the Venser ability not targeting Venser, creating two copies of the chosen permanent with haste.
Resolve the other Venser ability, creating two token copies of Venser with haste.
Repeat from step 6.
5540-6084-8195.notes: Additional results can be provided by the permanent you decide to copy in step 8, including landfall triggers and artifact ETB. You can forego Deflecting Swat's mana cost if you either control a commander or if an opponent controls a commander that you can swap control of Venser with. If Venser is your commander, it won't reduce Deflecting Swat's cost as you swap control of Venser prior to casting Deflecting Swat.

2034-5189-6441.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-5189-6441.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature token, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat.

1436-5261-7280.easyPrerequisites:
Call to Glory is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
1436-5261-7280.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
1436-5261-7280.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Donatello.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Call to Glory without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Call to Glory, untapping all creatures you control and giving Samurai you control +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

1981-2415-4050-7192.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding one mana of any color
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

277-4365-4772-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

4-1170-7495.description:
Cast All Aboard using the convoke ability from Hoarding Broodlord by tapping Skycoach Conductor.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Skycoach Conductor, which enters prepared.
Resolve All Aboard.
Repeat.

1368-4742-6006-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4742-6006-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1491-2033-6218-7315.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1354-1494-4613-7152.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Thing.
1354-1494-4613-7152.description:
Cast Wurmcalling with buyback by paying {2}{G}{G}, returning it to your hand.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Thing's first ability triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Declare The Thing as an attacker. Its second ability triggers, causing you to pay {R}{G}{W}{U} to double the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate The Thing using Sage of Hours' ability by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
1354-1494-4613-7152.notes: You can cast any noncreature spell in lieu of Wurmcalling. Wurmcalling is strongly recommended as it guarantees you can cast a noncreature spell each turn, but you may omit it at your discretion.

2919-3330-3490-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3330-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1017-3532-5078-7010.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
1017-3532-5078-7010.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3041-6899.description:
Deal damage to Coalhauler Swine.
Coalhauler Swine triggers, dealing that much damage to each player. Any damage that would be dealt to you is instead dealt to Coalhauler Swine due to With Great Power....
Repeat step 2.

1077-2438-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 2.

3497-4484-4871-5643-6797.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
3497-4484-4871-5643-6797.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
3497-4484-4871-5643-6797.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Phantom Train abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
3497-4484-4871-5643-6797.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1170-4124-5478-5954-6751.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Spelunking
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1174-1479-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control two lands that can tap to produce at least {2}, one of which must enter the battlefield untapped.
1174-1479-5702.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Play the land returned to your hand in step 2.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers.
Holding priority, activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Resolve the Kodama trigger from step 7, putting the land returned to your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, creating a token.
Repeat from step 7.

2538-3558-3676-5187.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Tangleroot triggers, adding {G}.
When Crookshank Kobolds enters the battlefield, Guardian Project triggers.
Holding priority, activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, replacing the next card you draw.
Resolve the Guardian Project trigger, causing you to return Crookshank Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

190-389-2782.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Nevinyrral at instant speed.
190-389-2782.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Nine Lives and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Nine Lives triggers. Holding priority, kill Nevinyrral at instant speed.
When Nevinyrral dies, it triggers, destroying all creatures, artifacts and/or enchantments.
Each opponent's Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, causing them to lose the game.

177-1623-5908.notablePrerequisites: There is another noncreature spell on the stack.
177-1623-5908.description:
Cast Psionic Pulse by paying {2}{U}, targeting another noncreature spell currently on the stack.
Gorion triggers, copying Psionic Pulse, with the copy targeting the original Psionic Pulse.
Resolve the copy of Psionic Pulse, causing you to exile the original Psionic Pulse, and cast it from exile without paying its mana cost, targeting another noncreature spell due to Guile.
Repeat from step 2.

2867-4636-5147-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Robot.
When the Robot dies, Demon of Dark Schemes' second ability triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1379-1558-1908-3866.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Rionya triggers, creating at least one token copy of Abhorrent Overlord with haste.
When the Abhorrent Overlord token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Harpy creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Abhorrent Overlord token and the Harpy tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2060-4289-4687.notablePrerequisites:
Crystalline Crawler has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
2060-4289-4687.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler, you may instead double the counters on any other permanent(s).

1766-2043-3499-4365.description:
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Thran Dynamo that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
Activate both Thran Dynamo tokens' abilities by tapping them, adding six {C}.
Repeat from step 2.

3784-4222-5115.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Vhal.
Vhal does not have summoning sickness.
3784-4222-5115.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {2}, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Vhal.
Repeat.

280-1479-3875.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
280-1479-3875.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it, Tireless Provisioner, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

933-1171-2104.notablePrerequisites:
You have not cast a copy of Regrowth using Garth's ability.
Garth does not have summoning sickness.
933-1171-2104.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Garth by tapping it, causing you to pay {1}{G} to cast a copy of Regrowth.
Resolve Regrowth, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Garth.
Repeat each turn.

1721-3505-4659.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three additional nontoken artifacts.
Artifacts you control that enter the battlefield untapped can produce at least {W}{W}.
1721-3505-4659.description:
Activate all mana-producing artifacts you control by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing any nontoken artifact besides itself or Codex Shredder, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 2 for each remaining applicable nontoken artifact you control.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing itself, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Codex Shredder by paying {5}, tapping and sacrificing it, returning Second Sunrise from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Second Sunrise by paying {1}{W}{W}, returning all artifacts, lands, creatures and enchantments that were put into a graveyard this turn onto the battlefield under their owner's control.
Repeat.
1721-3505-4659.notes: This combo also works with one less mana available from lands, producing every results except the infinite mana.
